title: Cancer regression in patients after transfer of genetically engineered lymphocytes.
decision: DMF4 original trial; complete engineered construct not established by beta CDR3 alone.

title: Gene therapy with human and mouse T-cell receptors mediates cancer regression and targets normal tissues expressing cognate antigen.
decision: Human DMF5 versus murine gp100154: quarantine TRAIT rows 3 and 6 rather than transfer DMF4 CDR3s.

title: Tumor regression in patients with metastatic synovial cell sarcoma and melanoma using genetically engineered lymphocytes reactive with NY-ESO-1.
decision: 1G4 alpha95LY; follow-up PMID25538264 overlaps cohort: do not add denominators.

title: Cancer regression and neurological toxicity following anti-MAGE-A3 TCR gene therapy.
decision: A*02 MAGE-A3/A9/A12 neurological toxicity; distinct from A*01 a3a titin. 3 neurological cases, 2 deaths; no inferred peptide-wide fatal labels.

title: Cardiovascular toxicity and titin cross-reactivity of affinity-enhanced T cells in myeloma and melanoma.
decision: A*01 affinity-enhanced MAGE-A3 a3a; 2 fatal cardiac cases linked to titin investigation. Historically exposed receptor family.

title: Adoptive transfer of MART-1 T-cell receptor transgenic lymphocytes and dendritic cell vaccination in patients with metastatic melanoma.
decision: DMF5 plus dendritic vaccine and IL2; 14 enrolled, 13 treated. Historically exposed family.

title: A pilot trial using lymphocytes genetically engineered with an NY-ESO-1-reactive T-cell receptor: long-term follow-up and correlates with response.
decision: Long-term NYESO1 follow-up; 18 sarcoma plus20 melanoma; overlaps PMID21282551, not an independent validation cohort.

title: NY-ESO-1-specific TCR-engineered T cells mediate sustained antigen-specific antitumor effects in myeloma.
decision: NYESO1 c259 plus autologous transplant;20patients; cannot attribute survival to receptor alone.

title: Treatment of Patients With Metastatic Cancer Using a Major Histocompatibility Complex Class II-Restricted T-Cell Receptor Targeting the Cancer Germline Antigen MAGE-A3.
decision: MHC-II restricted6F9 MAGE-A3 receptor;17patients. Keep separate from both class-I toxicity receptors.

title: Safety and persistence of WT1-specific T-cell receptor gene-transduced lymphocytes in patients with AML and MDS.
decision: WT1 TAK1 with endogenous-TCR siRNA and post-transfer peptide vaccination;8patients; no observed normal tissue toxicity is not proof of nonbinding.

title: Clinical and immunologic evaluation of three metastatic melanoma patients treated with autologous melanoma-reactive TCR-transduced T cells.
decision: Tyrosinase TIL1383I;3patients; later high-dose IL2 response not initial TCR-alone response. Historically exposed family.

title: Antitumor Activity Associated with Prolonged Persistence of Adoptively Transferred NY-ESO-1 <sup>c259</sup>T Cells in Synovial Sarcoma.
decision: NYESO1 c259 NCT01343043; overlaps subsequent mechanistic and biomarker analyses.

title: Treatment of metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with NY-ESO-1 specific TCR engineered-T cells in a phase I clinical trial: A case report.
decision: One NSCLC patient described in detail within a four-patient phase-I safety cohort; do not generalize construct identity to all 1G4 variants.

title: A Pilot Trial of the Combination of Transgenic NY-ESO-1-reactive Adoptive Cellular Therapy with Dendritic Cell Vaccination with or without Ipilimumab.
decision: NYESO1 plus dendritic vaccine with/without ipilimumab; retain combination arms.

title: T cell receptor gene therapy targeting WT1 prevents acute myeloid leukemia relapse post-transplant.
decision: WT1 C4 post-allogeneic-transplant relapse prevention; disease prevention endpoint distinct from response of measurable tumor.

title: T-Cell Receptor Gene Therapy for Human Papillomavirus-Associated Epithelial Cancers: A First-in-Human, Phase I/II Study.
decision: HPV16 E6 clinical trial;12patients; distinguish E7 receptor and condition-specific functional activity.

title: Systemic and local immunity following adoptive transfer of NY-ESO-1 SPEAR T cells in synovial sarcoma.
decision: NYESO1 SPEAR NCT01343043 mechanistic analysis, not an additional independent cohort.

title: CRISPR-engineered T cells in patients with refractory cancer.
decision: NYESO1 engineered T cells also edited at endogenous TCR and PDCD1;3patients. Not interchangeable with unedited1G4.

title: Selection of a Clinical Lead TCR Targeting Alpha-Fetoprotein-Positive Liver Cancer Based on a Balance of Risk and Benefit.
decision: PRECLINICAL AFP candidate selection; trial initiation is not clinical outcome data. Quarantine clinical outcome use.

title: TCR-engineered T cells targeting E7 for patients with metastatic HPV-associated epithelial cancers.
decision: HPV16 E7;12patients,6responses;patient11 DLT with baseline pulmonary progression. Complete preclinical coding insert source29669936; no public clinical-lot sequence certificate.

title: Anti-Mesothelin CAR T cell therapy for malignant mesothelioma.
decision: WRONG MODALITY: review of anti-mesothelin CAR-T, not WT1 TCR clinical evidence. Quarantine row75.

title: T-Cell Receptor Therapy in the Treatment of Ovarian Cancer: A Mini Review.
decision: SECONDARY REVIEW of ovarian TCR therapy, not a primary clinical outcome source. Quarantine direct outcome use.

title: Immunotherapy of HBV-related advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with short-term HBV-specific TCR expressed T cells: results of dose escalation, phase I trial.
decision: HBV transient-mRNA TCR trial;8patients; retain Table2 patient outcomes, no generic safe label.

title: Phase I clinical trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of ADP-A2M10 SPEAR T cells in patients with MAGE-A10<sup>+</sup> advanced non-small cell lung cancer.
decision: MAGEA10 ADP-A2M10;11patients; fatal aplastic anemia after enhanced lymphodepletion cannot be labelled off-target receptor death.

title: Neoantigen T-Cell Receptor Gene Therapy in Pancreatic Cancer.
decision: KRASG12D;1patient received 2distinct TCRs;72percent regression ongoing6months. Keep a single combination outcome, not2independent successes.

title: Adoptive Cellular Therapy with Autologous Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes and T-cell Receptor-Engineered T Cells Targeting Common p53 Neoantigens in Human Solid Tumors.
decision: p53 study has12TIL recipients and1engineered-TCR recipient4349 using donor4196 receptor; do not conflate donor with treated patient.

title: MART-1 TCR gene-modified peripheral blood T cells for the treatment of metastatic melanoma: a phase I/IIa clinical trial.
decision: 1D3HMCys MART1;12patients;patient1grade5toxicity;2/11assessable PR. Engineered constant regions and dose matter.

title: Efficacy of pp65-specific TCR-T cell therapy in treating cytomegalovirus infection after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
decision: CMVpp65 donor TCRs;7entered and6completed; C22/C27/C45 do not imply3independent trials. Full text not retrieved in this audit.

title: Biomarker correlates with response to NY-ESO-1 TCR T cells in patients with synovial sarcoma.
decision: Posthoc biomarker analysis of45NYESO1 c259 NCT01343043 patients; overlap with earlier trial reports.

title: Non-viral precision T cell receptor replacement for personalized cell therapy.
decision: 37receptors/16patients;36CDR3-DNA concordant variable pairs,1conflict;1-3TCRs perpatient; sequence and outcome linked by patient ID.

title: Autologous T cell therapy for MAGE-A4<sup>+</sup> solid cancers in HLA-A*02<sup>+</sup> patients: a phase 1 trial.
decision: ADP-A2M4/afami-cel phase1;38patients;same lineage as phase2, not independent receptor family.

title: Afamitresgene autoleucel for advanced synovial sarcoma and myxoid round cell liposarcoma (SPEARHEAD-1): an international, open-label, phase 2 trial.
decision: SPEARHEAD1 phase2 afami-cel;52patients;37percent response andCRS37/52. Same receptor as phase1, not new receptor family.
